Stories: SPK-01: Confirm Unipile capabilities before the architecture is committed
Task Description: Spike: ask Unipile whether a dedicated IP / residential proxy is provided per connected account, matched to the member's geography
Remarks: BLOCKER. Dedicated IP is how Expandi/Dripify keep accounts alive. If Unipile does not provide it, a proxy layer must be budgeted (~$3-10/user/month) and added to this epic.

Stories: SPK-01: Confirm Unipile capabilities before the architecture is committed
Task Description: Confirm current per-account pricing tiers and per-account rate limits; record findings in docs/vendor-notes.md
Remarks: Last checked Oct 2026: EUR 49/mo up to 10 accounts, then EUR 3-5 per account. Re-verify before pricing is set.

Stories: US-1.0: Sprint setup
Task Description: Create branch feature/multi-tenant-linkedin; raise the sprint board; confirm acceptance criteria with the product owner
Remarks: Branch off main at the current initial commit.

Stories: US-1.1: Store a user's LinkedIn connection

Stories: US-1.1: Store a user's LinkedIn connection
Task Description: Write the Alembic migration and verify the upgrade and downgrade round-trip against a copy of the dev database
Remarks: Downgrade must be tested, not just written. Follow the pattern in migration b4c1d9e27f30.

Stories: US-1.2: Platform credentials are encrypted at rest
Task Description: Add app/security/encryption.py with Fernet encrypt/decrypt helpers keyed by PLATFORM_CREDENTIAL_KEY
Remarks: Sits beside the existing passwords.py and tokens.py modules.

Stories: US-1.2: Platform credentials are encrypted at rest
Task Description: Add PLATFORM_CREDENTIAL_KEY to Settings and .env.example; refuse to start in production when it is unset or too short
Remarks: Mirror the existing production guard on JWT_SECRET_KEY in app/config/settings.py.

Task Description: Unit tests: encrypt/decrypt round-trip, a wrong key fails closed, a missing key is refused in production
Remarks: Must fail closed, never fall back to storing plaintext.

Stories: US-1.3: Connect my LinkedIn account without sharing my password
Task Description: Integrate the Unipile Hosted Auth Wizard: request a hosted auth link scoped to the signed-in user
Remarks: We never see or store the member's LinkedIn password. This is the liability boundary.

Stories: US-1.3: Connect my LinkedIn account without sharing my password
Task Description: Handle the success and failure callback; persist the returned account_id against the user
Remarks: Handle the user abandoning the wizard midway without leaving a half-created row.

Stories: US-1.3: Connect my LinkedIn account without sharing my password
Task Description: Validate the callback signature so a forged callback cannot bind an attacker's account to another user
Remarks: Security-critical. Unsigned callbacks must be rejected, not merely logged.

Stories: US-1.4: Manage my own connection
Task Description: Add POST /api/integrations/linkedin/connect-link, GET /status and DELETE /disconnect, all scoped to the current user
Remarks: Use the existing CurrentUser dependency from app/api/deps.py.

Stories: US-1.4: Manage my own connection
Task Description: Pydantic schemas and OpenAPI docs; never return the encrypted credential or the raw Unipile token to the browser
Remarks: Same rule the settings endpoint already follows: no secrets cross the wire.

Stories: US-1.4: Manage my own connection
Task Description: Integration tests: user A cannot read, reuse or disconnect user B's connection
Remarks: Follow the isolation pattern already in tests/integration/test_auth.py. Must 404, not 403.

Remarks: HIGHEST RISK TASK OF THE SPRINT. Today one global adapter serves the whole process. Allow two full days.

Stories: US-1.5: The agent acts through my connection, not a shared one
Task Description: Add a bounded per-account adapter cache keyed by unipile_account_id, closing the HTTP client on eviction
Remarks: Unbounded caching leaks httpx clients once there are many users.

Stories: US-1.5: The agent acts through my connection, not a shared one
Task Description: Keep the mock, brightdata and composite paths working so the existing 264 backend tests stay green
Remarks: The mock adapter path must not require a connected account, or the whole test suite breaks.

Stories: US-1.5: The agent acts through my connection, not a shared one
Task Description: Pass the campaign owner's adapter into AgentController and WorkflowEngine instead of the global default

Stories: US-1.6: Tell me when my LinkedIn connection drops

Stories: US-1.6: Tell me when my LinkedIn connection drops
Task Description: Reconnect flow re-uses the hosted auth link and updates the existing row rather than creating a duplicate
Remarks: Reconnection is the most common support case for this class of product.
